name: soulm8te
description: soulm8te — Electron browser with private sessions, tab sleeping and native Chromium tabs.

scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.test:e2e:smoke: node scripts/electron-smoke.mjs && node scripts/login-import-smoke.mjs && node scripts/notifications-smoke.mjs && node scripts/youtube-cookies-smoke.mjs && node scripts/popup-smoke.mjs && node scripts/tab-search-smoke.mjs && node scripts/manager-smoke.mjs && node scripts/password-manager-smoke.mjs && node scripts/manager-ui-regression.mjs && node scripts/media-smoke.mjs && node scripts/background-smoke.mjs && node scripts/session-budget-smoke.mjs && node scripts/chrome-features-smoke.mjs && node scripts/reader-security-smoke.mjs && node scripts/notes-race-smoke.mjs && node scripts/memory-release-smoke.mjs && node scripts/pip-smoke.mjs && node scripts/renderer-actions-smoke.mjs
scripts.dist:deb: npm run build && electron-builder --linux deb --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb --publish never
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run check:release-assets
scripts.test:e2e:features: node scripts/split-view-smoke.mjs && node scripts/bookmark-export-smoke.mjs && node scripts/youtube-icons-smoke.mjs
